summary: Pastefy is a self-hosted pastebin application used for storing and sharing snippets of text or code. It features a highlighted editor, multi-tab pastes, an application programming interface, and optional client-side encryption.
goodFor: It is a suitable choice if you need a lightweight, easily deployable alternative to public paste services for internal text sharing.
watchOut: Development activity has recently slowed down, which could mean slower responses to security issues or bugs.
deployNotes: Since it runs via Docker and Kubernetes, you will typically need to configure persistent storage for your paste data and place it behind a reverse proxy for TLS termination.
